<?php
class BaseA140 {
    public string $baseSide = "B";
    public const TAG = "T";
}
class GetterA140 extends BaseA140 {
    public int $value = 7 {
        &get { echo "G:", __CLASS__, "/", static::class, "/", $this->baseSide, "|"; return $this->value; }
    }
}
class ChildA140 extends GetterA140 {
    public int $value = 11;
    public $side = "S";
}
class LeafA140 extends ChildA140 {
    public function __destruct() { echo "D|"; }
}
echo "A:", LeafA140::TAG, "/";
$object = new LeafA140;
echo $object->baseSide, "/", $object->side, "|";
$alias =& $object->value;
echo $alias === 11 ? "alias11|" : "bad-alias|";
$alias = "12";
echo $alias === 12 ? "typed12|" : "bad-type|";
$copy = $object->value;
$alias = 13;
echo $copy === 12 ? "copy12|" : "bad-copy|";
echo $alias === 13 ? "live13|" : "bad-live|";
unset($object);
$alias = "free";
echo $alias === "free" ? "free|Z|" : "bad-free|";
